svg.aria-label: The annotator starts with an empty screen. A screen-sharing app connects the two machines and the host's screen appears in a window. Remote Annotate then connects them as well, and its target area is moved and resized until it matches that shared image; pressing Start turns the border red and begins annotating. Three clicks and a circle drawn around a block of code appear on the host's real screen as they are made, each fading on its own.
svg.title: Remote Annotate — how a session runs
